description: Required format for /app/report.json. Produce by running branch coverage analysis and transforming the JSON output into this structure.

fields.total_statements: integer — total executable statements across all measured files
fields.covered_statements: integer — number of statements executed during testing
fields.total_branches: integer — total branch points (requires branch coverage mode)
fields.covered_branches: integer — number of branches taken during testing
fields.branch_coverage_percent: number — branch coverage as a percentage (must be >= 85.0)
fields.files: object — mapping from relative file paths to per-file metrics
